testCases.title: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: Registered user jane@example.com exists with a known password

steps.expectedResult: Login form is displayed with email and password fields

steps.action: Enter the email and password from test data and submit
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the dashboard and a session cookie is set

postconditions: User has an active authenticated session

steps.action: Enter the email and wrong password and submit
steps.expectedResult: Error 'Invalid email or password' is shown and user stays on the login page
